description: No shared walls, no HOA (no surprise 'special assessments' or an HOA board to deal with), and high-end finishes on this 2017 new build, 2-bedroom, 2 bath single family house! The main picture shows two of these houses side-by-side, but they are not joined. Enjoy a stunning open floorplan, a beautifully designed kitchen, and a modern contemporary living within walking distance to the intersection of Laurel Canyon and Ventura Boulevard and all shops and restaurants. With no grounds or yard, this is ideal if you're a busy professional. Located in the coveted Carpenter School district, with direct garage access and an interior charging station, as well as a massive, private rooftop deck that spans the length of the building. Entertain on summer nights or just use it as your own private oasis. A rare, move-in ready home on a beautiful street, in a stunning neighborhood.
